description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment Uduwana, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520002
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing changes to parcel numbers, land extents, ownership status, access rights, and encumbrances for various land parcels in the Homagama area. The content is purely land and property-related, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
